implementation.behavior: Each unfinished creation stage rechecks the CLI/VM fingerprint before recording the stage as running or executing it. A changed or newly unreadable pair raises toolChanged and preserves the completed checkpoint.

red.reported_result: Two tests, three parameterized scenarios, 11 issues; the previous implementation continued through patch and verification after replacing CLI/VM or deleting VM.

limits: A stage-boundary check does not make executables immutable during a stage or eliminate replacement after the check.
The tool fingerprint covers CLI and paired VM bytes only; scripts, guest payloads, Python and external caches remain outside it.
Fresh creation does not currently publish per-VM launchpad.json binding.
This change alone does not satisfy the complete T40 creation-toolchain contract.

resource_audit.VPhoneResources.runtimeResources: Required-resource URL list, not a complete digest manifest. Some actual dependencies are dynamically selected Python environments or external caches.
resource_audit.embedded_toolchain_json: Outer signature seals nested CLI and VM CDHashes; it does not supply a complete development/resource-override digest.
resource_audit.signed_CodeResources: App sealing can cover packaged resources; there is no current uniform create-time manifest covering all runtime-selected dependencies.

transfer_probe.result: Actual CLI new/clone/rename/export/import completed on a synthetic 0 GiB VM bundle. Eight persistent files retain size, SHA256 and mode. Four constructed origin fields and an opaque historical receipt copy retain exact bytes.
transfer_probe.initial_failure: The initial source-inventory comparison included .vphone-runtime.json created by the source lock. The failed script and result are retained. The corrected persistent inventory excludes the production runtime record and control socket.
limits: ROM bytes are explicitly synthetic and the disk is 0 GiB. No VM launched, restored or booted.
The binding is constructed fixture data, not a binding issued by a current production store operation.

The historical receipt is copied as an opaque evidence file inside the fixture VM. Production receipt trust remains in the root-owned Bundle store, which this probe does not install, transfer or verify.
No real 64 GiB archive round trip or actual guest/kernel/environment upgrade or rollback is established.

legacy_helper_probe.state: source prepared; not compiled, signed, registered or executed by this subagent
legacy_helper_probe.purpose: A controlled protocol-v1 XPC service returns version 1, exposes only old install/verify selectors and logs any attempted operation. Production client install/verify should reject version mismatch before requesting authorization, opening an operation log or submitting an operation.
limits: This is a controlled compatibility fixture, not a historical helper executable.
The fixture listener itself does not implement production caller-identity checks; those checks require independent real-helper rejection evidence.
Parent agent owns build, signing, launchd installation, baseline capture and cleanup.

static_evidence: Launchpad and CLI Info.plist contain location usage descriptions.
VPhoneLocationProvider creates CLLocationManager and calls requestAlwaysAuthorization/startUpdatingLocation inside the VM executable.
The ordinary launcher spawns its child without responsibility disclaiming.
TCC.remaining: Observe the responsible process/app and allow/deny behavior for Launchpad foreground bound launch, detached create and direct CLI routes. Static metadata, preset location and guest RPC do not establish Host CoreLocation authorization.
